name: Earthly Rewards
overview: Scripture warns believers against seeking earthly riches or recognition, emphasizing that true reward comes from God in heaven rather than from human approval or material gain. While the wicked pursue deceitful gain, those who sow righteousness are assured a sure reward, yet Christians are cautioned not to perform acts of righteousness for public acclaim to avoid losing their heavenly reward. Earthly treasures are temporary and vulnerable to decay and theft, and no worldly profit can compensate for the loss of one's soul, highlighting the eternal value of heavenly rewards over transient earthly ones.
